newsitem.title: UK: Walenkamp elected vice president of ISU.
newsitem.headline: Walenkamp elected vice president of ISU.

text.p: Hans Walenkamp has been elected vice president of the International Salvage Union at its annual general meeting in Gothenburg, Sweden.
Walenkamp is Group Director, Salvage, for Smit Internationale NV.

The marine salvors' association said Walenkamp has been responsible for many major salvage operations, including the ferry Herald of Free Enterprise which capzised of Zeebrugge in 1987 with the loss of nearly 200 lives.
Walenkamp has been a member of the ISU's executive committee since 1994.

Three other members were elected the ISU executive committee: Christopher Pooley of The Hong Kong Salvage & Towage Co Ltd, Dale Cole of United Salvage Pty Ltd in Australia and Iain Buchanan of Ocean Group Plc unit Cory Towage Ltd from the UK.
